items.name: Beef or Chicken Suya

items.name: Jollof Box

items.name: Fully Loaded Fries
items.description: French Fries loaded with our take time sauce and beef Suya.

items.name: Flyer Than Fly Mountain Burger
items.description: Our signature mountain burger taking things to first-class altitude. A juicy plant-based mountain burger stacked with sweet plantain, crisp lettuce, crispy onions and creamy vegan mayo, all tucked inside a soft vegan butter bun. Pure Flygerian flavour, no turbulence. Add suya spice.

items.name: Oga on Top Burger
items.description: When one patty isn't enough, Oga goes on top. Two seasoned beef patties layered with melted cheese, sweet plantain, fresh onions and crisp lettuce, served in a toasted brioche bun brushed with our homemade garlic butter. Finished with our signature sweet and hot sauce on the side for dipping, drizzling or doing the most.

items.name: Flygerian Crispy Chicken Burger
items.description: A crispy chicken thigh fillet, coated in seasoned cornflour and fried until golden perfection. Served in a buttery brioche bun with fresh lettuce, crispy onions, homemade garlic butter and our house burger sauce. Comes with sweet and hot sauce on the side for that signature Flygerian kick. Add cheese for £1.

items.name: Keep It Simple Cheese Burger
items.description: 2 beef patties with a slice of cheese and crispy onions.

items.name: Jerk & Jollof
items.description: Juicy jerk chicken legs and thighs marinated in bold Caribbean spices and flame-grilled to BBQ perfection. Served with smoky jollof rice and plantain.

items.name: BBQ Corn on the Cob
items.description: Charred corn smothered in homemade garlic, parsley and Himalayan salt butter. Simple. Smoky. Elite.

items.name: Chin'offe Pie
items.description: Flygerian chin chin pie layered with banana and caramel, topped with whipped cream and sprinkled with Milo.

items.name: Plantain Ice Cream
items.description: Homemade vanilla plantain ice cream.

items.name: Chin Chin Crumble
items.description: Flygerian chin chin crumble served with sweet creamy custard. Our twist on a British classic dessert.
